form.companyOverview: Altiplano is a Mexico-based real estate development and private equity platform led by Diego Fernández Briseño. The firm's first hospitality-led mixed-use project is Mijares 32 in historic San José del Cabo — a ~52-key boutique hotel with 36 branded residences, ground-floor F&B, and shared underground parking. Legal entity: North Blue Ventures LLC d/b/a Altiplano.
